faqs.q: Sec. 54-154. - Failure to pay a civil parking citation.
faqs.a:
(a)
The driver or registered owner of a motor vehicle charged with a violation of the
               restrictions on stopping, standing, or parking pursuant to this division must respond
               within 15 calendar days of the date of the citation by payment of the applicable civil
               penalty as provided by the city.
(b)
If the applicable civil penalty is not paid within such 15 calendar day period, the
               director of public works or designee thereof may petition the municipal court, setting
               forth the facts and circumstances of the case, and seeking that a show cause order
               be issued to the driver or registered owner. The municipal court is authorized to
               issue a show cause notice to the driver or registered owner to appear before the court
               and show cause why such payment was not made, under penalty of punishment for contempt.
(c)
Service of the show cause notice shall be made by mailing the notice to the last known
               address of the driver or registered owner by certified mail, return receipt requested,
               not less than seven calendar days prior to the time the driver or registered owner
               is required to appear in municipal court.
(d)
Should the driver or registered owner not appear in municipal court following service
               of the show cause order, the court is authorized to enter a default judgment in favor
               of the city for the amount of the citation and any late fees, or other administrative
               costs and fees.
(e)
The city may assess a late fee for any parking citation that is not paid within 15
               calendar days of the date of the citation.
(Ord. No.
4561
, § 2, 8-29-2016; Ord. No.
4794
, § 1, 4-4-2022)
